_doc: Inheritance grounds (W-006, Inheritances). One-time trials left by a fallen master; only one cultivator in the world can claim each. Per inheritance: id, name, description, region (regions.json id where the grounds lie), appears_years (years after the game starts when they are found), deadline_years (after this, a rival claims it unless the player already has; rival_news is the log line then), stages passed in order, and reward (shared Effects keys, granted when the last stage is passed). Per stage: name, text, days (time spent passing it), test: "realm" (min_realm, realms.json id), "attribute" (attribute id, min), "alignment" (min_alignment and/or max_alignment) or "fight" (enemy, enemies.json id; never lethal, retry on defeat). Progress is kept per character in CharacterData.trial_progress.

inheritances.name: Grave of the Wandering Fist Saint
inheritances.description: A mossy cairn deep in the Misty Forest, where a body-tempering master who never joined a sect lies with his last lesson.
inheritances.rival_news: Word spreads that a young Azure Cloud disciple has claimed the Grave of the Wandering Fist Saint.

stages.name: Cairn Gate
stages.text: Words carved into the cairn: "Only those who have begun the path may knock."

stages.name: Stone of Endurance
stages.text: A boulder hums with earth qi. You must hold it aloft for a day and a night.

stages.name: Ape of the Grave
stages.text: The saint's old companion, a stone ape, rises to test your fists.

inheritances.name: Altar of the Corpse Lord
inheritances.description: A sunken altar in the Withered Bone Marsh where a demonic master hid his arts from the righteous sects that hunted him.
inheritances.rival_news: The marsh falls silent: a Blood Lotus elder has claimed the Altar of the Corpse Lord.

stages.name: Drowned Steps
stages.text: Black water parts only for those whose qi has a foundation.

stages.name: Mirror of Sins
stages.text: A mirror of polished bone shows your heart. The Corpse Lord had no use for saints.

stages.name: Puppet Warden
stages.text: A bronze corpse puppet lurches from the altar, still obeying its dead master.

inheritances.name: Well of the Village Founder
inheritances.description: Qingshi's founder was a minor cultivator who hid his last lesson at the bottom of the village well, for a child of the village with a kind heart.
inheritances.rival_news: Word spreads that the headman's grandson climbed out of the old well with a glowing jade slip.

stages.name: Rope of the Well
stages.text: The rope is old. Only someone who has begun to cultivate could climb down and back.

stages.name: Founder's Question
stages.text: A voice echoes from the stones: 'What would you do for a stranger in need?'

stages.name: Bandit in the Dark
stages.text: A bandit lord who followed the same rumor waits at the bottom, saber drawn.

inheritances.name: Cave of the Cloud-Sword Immortal
inheritances.description: High on Azure Peak, a cave sealed by sword qi that has not faded in a thousand years. The immortal who carved it left his canon for a sword cultivator of upright heart.
inheritances.rival_news: The heavens over Azure Peak split with sword light: someone has claimed the Cave of the Cloud-Sword Immortal.

stages.name: Sword Seal
stages.text: The seal only parts for a cultivator who has formed a foundation.

stages.name: Mirror of the Upright Heart
stages.text: A sword-polished mirror shows you your own heart.

stages.name: Ten Thousand Sword Inscriptions
stages.text: The walls are covered in sword strokes. You must read their intent.

stages.name: Inner Sanctum
stages.text: The final door weighs on your soul. Only a Core Formation cultivator can bear it.

stages.name: The Immortal's Roc
stages.text: The immortal's old mount, a thunderwing roc, still guards his bones.

inheritances.name: Vault of the Blood Merchant King
inheritances.description: Beneath Fallen Star Market lies the vault of a merchant who traded in lives. Its door opens only for those who would do the same.
inheritances.rival_news: A Blood Lotus elder has emptied the Vault of the Blood Merchant King; the market whispers of nothing else.

stages.name: Toll of Blood
stages.text: The door asks for blood, and the blood of a foundation cultivator at that.

stages.name: Ledger of Lives
stages.text: The vault reads the ledger of your deeds. It does not care for mercy.

stages.name: Vault Warden
stages.text: A Blood Lotus executioner bound to the vault by a blood oath attacks.

stages.name: Inner Vault
stages.text: The last chamber drinks the qi of anyone weaker than Core Formation.
